title: FSRC-R and CT-RCT-PYTHON and SQL-STAFF
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**EY GDS – RCT**
**Staff – Python & Advanced SQL**
**Staff – Software Engineering**
**Experience: Strictly 2+ years**
**Eligibility requirement:**
Candidates must have 2–4 years of relevant professional experience, including hands-on cloud experience. Freshers, candidates with less than 2 years of experience, and candidates without cloud experience are not eligible for this role.
  
  
**The opportunity**
Join a financial crime technology team building data-driven solutions for global financial services clients. This role combines hands-on Python engineering, advanced SQL development, and practical exposure to Financial Crime Compliance processes. You will work with business, compliance, data, and engineering stakeholders to deliver reliable solutions across KYC, AML, Transaction Monitoring, Sanctions, and Fraud.
  
  
**Role Overview**
We are seeking a hands-on software engineer with strong Python and advanced SQL skills and relevant Financial Crime Compliance domain experience. The successful candidate will develop and support data-intensive applications, analytical workflows, and rule-based solutions used in customer due diligence, transaction monitoring, sanctions screening, fraud detection, investigations, and regulatory reporting.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Design, develop, test, and maintain Python applications, services, utilities, and data-processing workflows.
* Write complex, optimized SQL for data extraction, transformation, reconciliation, profiling, and investigation use cases.
* Work with large financial datasets, including customer, account, transaction, alert, case, and screening data.
* Translate Financial Crime Compliance requirements into technical designs, data rules, scenarios, and reusable components.
* Support KYC and AML workflows such as customer onboarding, customer risk rating, customer due diligence, enhanced due diligence, and periodic review.
* Contribute to Transaction Monitoring, Sanctions, and Fraud solutions, including rule implementation, threshold logic, alert generation, data validation, and issue analysis.
* Develop APIs, batch jobs, automation scripts, and integration components using Python.
* Perform unit testing, code reviews, debugging, root-cause analysis, and production support.
* Collaborate with compliance SMEs, business analysts, data engineers, QA teams, and client stakeholders in Agile delivery teams.
* Follow secure coding, version-control, documentation, and deployment practices.

**Primary Skills – Must Have**

* Python: Strong hands-on programming experience, including data structures, functions, object-oriented programming, exception handling, modules, logging, testing, and performance-conscious coding.
* Advanced SQL: Strong command of complex joins, subqueries, common table expressions, window functions, aggregations, query optimization, stored procedures, and data reconciliation.
* Databases: Practical experience with at least one relational database such as PostgreSQL, Oracle, Microsoft SQL Server, or MySQL.
* Data engineering: Experience processing structured data using Python libraries such as pandas and integrating with databases, files, or APIs.
* APIs and services: Working knowledge of REST APIs and Python frameworks such as FastAPI, Flask, or Django.
* Engineering practices: Git, unit testing, code review, debugging, documentation, and CI/CD fundamentals.
* Cloud: Mandatory hands-on experience with at least one cloud platform: Microsoft Azure, AWS, or GCP. Candidates should have practical experience developing, deploying, or supporting data-driven applications or services in a cloud environment.

**Good to have**

* Experience with PySpark or distributed data processing.
* Familiarity with orchestration or ETL tools such as Airflow, Azure Data Factory, or equivalent.
* Experience with data visualization or reporting tools such as Power BI or Tableau.
* Understanding of model or rule performance measures, threshold tuning, false-positive reduction, and data lineage.
* Exposure to Agile delivery tools and practices, including Jira or Azure DevOps.

**Financial Crime domain knowledge**

* KYC / CDD / EDD: Customer onboarding, identity and document checks, customer risk rating, beneficial ownership, periodic review, and remediation.
* AML: Financial crime risk indicators, typologies, alert and case workflows, investigations, escalation, and regulatory reporting concepts.
* Transaction Monitoring (TM): Scenario or rule logic, thresholds, segmentation, alert generation, tuning support, back-testing, and data-quality controls.
* Sanctions: Customer and payment screening, watchlist concepts, potential-match handling, disposition workflows, and screening data quality.
* Fraud: Fraud indicators, rules or models, event and transaction analysis, alert triage, investigations, and case outcomes.

**Experience And Education**

* Experience: Strictly 2–4 years of relevant professional experience in software engineering, data engineering, analytics engineering, or technology delivery.
* Eligibility: Freshers and candidates with less than 2 years of relevant experience will not be considered.
* Cloud experience: Hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure, AWS, or GCP is mandatory.
* Domain experience: Relevant delivery experience in KYC, AML, Transaction Monitoring, Sanctions, or Fraud is good to have.
* Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, Data Science, or a related field.

**What Success Looks Like**

* Production-quality Python and SQL that is accurate, maintainable, secure, and efficient.
* Clear understanding of the business purpose and regulatory context behind the solution being built.
* Strong ownership of assigned deliverables, defects, documentation, and stakeholder communication.
* Ability to explain technical findings and data issues clearly to both engineering and compliance stakeholders.

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Senior QA Engineer
description:
Dodge Construction Network (Dodge) is looking for a Senior QA Engineer to own quality across a product area of our platform, from the user-facing web application down to the data it produces. This is a hands-on senior role: you'll set the test strategy for your area, write and maintain automation, and do the structured manual and exploratory testing that automation can't replace. Much of our product is data-processing and workflow logic, so correctness here means the right records, in the right state, with the right values, not just a page that renders. You'll verify that directly in the database, test APIs and integrations, keep test suites reliable in CI/CD, and extend quality into performance and application security. You'll work closely with developers and product, and your defect reports, test plans, and risk assessments will be clear enough that people can act on them without a follow-up conversation.
  
  
This is a full-time position and reports directly to the VP, Data Platform.
  
  
***Preferred Location***
Qualified candidates should be based in or near Kochi and able to work from our Kochi office as part of a hybrid schedule.
  
  
***Travel Requirements***
Expected travel is minimal for this role.
  
  
**Essential Functions**

* Own quality for an assigned product area end to end: define the test strategy, decide what to automate versus test manually, and be accountable for release readiness
* Design, build, and maintain automated end-to-end and UI tests using a modern browser automation framework (Playwright, Selenium WebDriver, or equivalent), working directly in the product codebase
* Plan and run structured manual and exploratory testing sessions to uncover edge cases, usability issues, and failure modes that scripted tests miss
* Test REST APIs and service integrations using automated suites and tools such as Postman, covering contract, functional, and negative scenarios
* Verify data-processing and workflow outcomes with SQL, writing joins across staging and production tables to confirm that pipelines produce the correct records, states, and values
* Create, manage, and reset test data independently to support repeatable, reliable test runs
* Integrate test suites into CI/CD pipelines and keep them fast, stable, and trustworthy over time, actively addressing flaky tests and coverage gaps
* Design and execute performance and load tests with tools such as JMeter, Gatling, or Locust, including defining realistic load profiles, analysing results, and identifying bottlenecks
* Write precise, reproducible defect reports and clear test documentation that developers can act on immediately
* Partner with engineering and product early in the development cycle to review requirements, identify risk, and build testability into features
* Raise the quality bar across the team by sharing practices, reviewing test code, and mentoring others in testing approaches

***Education Requirement***
Bachelor's degree in a related field or equivalent education and work experience.
  
  
**Required Experience, Knowledge And Skills**

* 5+ years in QA, with real seniority: you've owned quality for a product area, not just executed someone else's test plan
* Solid experience testing web applications end to end, combining hands-on automation with structured manual and exploratory testing. We need both; candidates who only do one will struggle here.
* You write code. Proficiency in at least one automation language (TypeScript/JavaScript, Python, Java or similar) and comfort working in a real codebase.
* Hands-on with a modern browser automation framework (Playwright, Selenium WebDriver or equivalent) and with API testing (REST clients, Postman or similar)
* Strong SQL. Non-negotiable — you'll be writing joins across staging and production tables to verify what the pipeline produced, and building and resetting your own test data.
* Experience testing data-processing or workflow systems where correctness means "the right records, in the right state, with the right values" rather than "the page rendered"
* Experience integrating test suites into CI/CD and keeping them reliable over time
* Performance testing with a real tool (JMeter, Gatling, Locust) — able to design a load profile, not just run one
* Clear, precise written communication. A defect report a developer can act on without a follow-up conversation is a skill, and we value it

**About Dodge Construction Network**
Dodge Construction Network exists to deliver the comprehensive data and connections the construction industry needs to build thriving communities. Our legacy is deeply rooted in empowering our customers with transformative insights, igniting their journey towards unparalleled business expansion and success. We serve decision-makers who seek reliable growth and who value relationships built on trust and quality. By combining our proprietary data with cutting-edge software, we deliver to our customers the essential intelligence needed to excel within their respective landscapes. We propel the construction industry forward by transforming data into tangible guidance, driving unparalleled advancement.
  
  
Dodge is the catalyst for modern construction.

title: Oracle - SCM and Procurement - SCM-Functional Consultant - Senior
description:
**Job Summary:**
We are seeking an experienced Oracle Fusion Cloud Supply Chain Management (SCM) and Procurement (PROC) Functional Consultant at Senior level with a minimum of 5 years of relevant experience. The successful candidate will independently support and deliver Oracle Fusion Cloud implementation, transformation, rollout and support engagements across Procurement and related SCM areas, including Self Service Procurement, Purchasing, Sourcing, Supplier Qualification and Management, Procurement Contracts, Inventory Management, Order Management, Product Management, Manufacturing, Supply Chain Planning, Cost Management, Maintenance and Logistics. The role requires strong hands-on functional capability, client-facing delivery experience and relevant industry/domain expertise to translate real-world source-to-pay and supply-chain requirements into scalable Oracle Fusion solutions. Knowledge of Oracle Redwood user experience and Oracle Fusion AI Agent Studio is also expected.
  
**Primary Responsibilities and Accountabilities:**
•Deliver Oracle Fusion Cloud SCM and Procurement implementation, transformation, rollout and support activities from requirements gathering through design, configuration, testing, deployment and stabilization.
  
•Manage assigned workstream tasks, plans, risks, issues, dependencies, quality and stakeholder updates under the guidance of the project lead or manager.
  
•Facilitate business workshops, assess current-state industry processes and translate requirements into scalable future-state Oracle Fusion SCM and Procurement solutions aligned with leading practices.
  
•Perform functional fit-gap analysis, configuration, prototyping, conference room pilots, testing, training, cutover and go-live support.
  
•Design integrated source-to-pay, procure-to-pay and supply-chain solutions across Procurement, Inventory Management, Order Management, Cost Management and related SCM modules, coordinating dependencies with Payables, Finance, Projects, reporting, integration, security and data teams.
  
•Prepare high-quality functional designs, configuration workbooks, process flows, test artefacts, user guides and training materials in line with Oracle implementation methodologies.
  
•Assess Oracle Redwood readiness, support business-process redesign for Redwood pages and guided experiences, and execute adoption, testing and change-impact activities.
  
•Identify suitable SCM use cases for Oracle Fusion AI Agent Studio and support the definition of agent topics, instructions, tools, data access, human-approval checkpoints and expected outcomes.
  
•Collaborate with technical, security and integration teams to configure, test, publish and monitor AI agents and agentic workflows within Oracle Fusion.
  
•Follow responsible AI controls covering role-based access, data privacy, traceability, testing, monitoring and business-owner approval.
  
•Support SIT, UAT, regression testing, cutover and production support, and drive timely resolution of defects and functional queries.
  
•Contribute to client presentations, solution demonstrations, estimates, proposals, knowledge assets and practice-development initiatives.
  
•Guide junior consultants, review assigned deliverables and maintain delivery quality and internal KPIs.
  
  
  
Requirements
  
  
**Experience:**
•Minimum 5 years of relevant Oracle SCM and Procurement experience, including strong hands-on experience with Oracle Fusion Cloud.
  
•At least two end-to-end ERP implementation or transformation engagements, including at least one Oracle Fusion Cloud SCM implementation.
  
•Strong functional expertise in Oracle Fusion Procurement—including Self Service Procurement, Purchasing, Sourcing, Supplier Qualification and Management, Supplier Portal and Procurement Contracts—together with hands-on knowledge of at least one core SCM area such as Inventory Management, Order Management, Manufacturing, Supply Chain Planning, Product Management, Cost Management, Maintenance or Logistics.
  
•Hands-on experience with source-to-pay and procure-to-pay process design, enterprise structures, procurement business units, requisitioning, purchasing, approvals, catalogs, supplier onboarding, sourcing, contracts, receiving, integrations, data migration, reporting and operational controls.
  
•Practical knowledge of Oracle Redwood UX, including Redwood page adoption, process redesign, extension considerations, testing and end-user change management.
  
•Working knowledge of Oracle Fusion AI Agent Studio, including agent configuration concepts, topics, instructions, tools, workflow orchestration, deployment, security and monitoring.
  
•Ability to support high-value agentic SCM use cases, such as supplier onboarding assistance, procurement policy guidance, order exception management, inventory insights or planning support.
  
•Client-facing delivery experience with sound planning, estimation, risk management, testing and quality assurance capabilities.
  
•Demonstrable industry/domain experience in at least one sector—such as retail, government, energy, real estate, oil and gas, manufacturing, utilities, logistics or consumer products—with practical understanding of sector-specific procurement, supplier, inventory, fulfilment, planning and operational-control requirements.
  
**Competencies / Skills:**
•Strong stakeholder management, consulting, collaboration and junior-team mentoring skills.
  
•Ability to independently manage assigned functional workstreams, priorities and deliverables within agreed timelines.
  
•Excellent verbal, written and presentation skills, with the ability to explain business and functional concepts clearly.
  
•Strong analytical, industry-process design, problem-solving and decision-making capabilities, with the ability to apply domain knowledge to Oracle Fusion SCM and Procurement solutions.
  
•Sound understanding of responsible AI, data privacy, access controls, human oversight and governance for enterprise agentic solutions.
  
•Awareness of Oracle quarterly updates and the ability to assess new SCM, Redwood and embedded-AI capabilities for business adoption.
  
•Proficiency in delivery and collaboration tools such as Microsoft Project, Jira, Azure DevOps or equivalent.
  
•Valid passport and willingness to travel to client sites and work MENA business schedules, including Sunday to Thursday, where required.
  
**Education:**
•Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Supply Chain Management, Operations, Business Administration, Information Systems or a related discipline; an MBA or relevant postgraduate qualification is preferred.
  
•Oracle Fusion Cloud SCM and/or Procurement certification in relevant modules is preferred; credentials or demonstrated training in Oracle Redwood and Oracle Fusion AI Agent Studio are an added advantage.

title: Test Lead
description:
**Job Summary**
This hybrid Test Lead role focuses on designing and driving high quality verification for embedded systems built on Windows XP Embedded using Robot Framework Python and Embedded C ensuring robust functionality for research and clinical oriented solutions that support innovation in bioinformatics and medical technology while collaborating closely with cross functional teams in a day shift environment.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Lead the end to end test strategy for embedded solutions based on Windows XP Embedded to ensure reliable performance and compliance with internal quality standards across all supported releases.
* Oversee the creation of comprehensive test plans and detailed test cases using Robot Framework and Python so that complex functional and regression scenarios are validated with traceable coverage.
* Provide hands on development of automated test scripts using Robot Framework and Python to improve repeatability reduce manual effort and accelerate feedback cycles in hybrid work settings.
* Coordinate embedded level verification by reviewing and executing tests targeting firmware modules written in Embedded C to confirm stability error handling and resource efficiency.
* Drive root cause analysis for defects identified during system and integration testing to support timely fixes and continuous improvement of embedded features and data handling logic.
* Collaborate with developers product owners and domain experts to refine requirements and acceptance criteria so that test designs reflect real world usage in research and clinical workflows.
* Implement robust test data management practices to simulate realistic scenarios for preclinical and clinical research use cases while safeguarding integrity and consistency.
* Monitor test execution progress and quality metrics prepare concise status reports and communicate risks to stakeholders to support informed decision making and release readiness.
* Optimize test environments for Windows XP Embedded systems by coordinating configuration deployment and maintenance activities that enable stable and repeatable test runs.
* Contribute to continuous improvement of test frameworks and utilities using Python by enhancing libraries tools and reusable components that raise productivity for the wider team.
* Guide defect lifecycle management activities by ensuring accurate defect documentation prioritization and verification so that critical issues affecting research and clinical workflows are resolved promptly.
* Align testing outcomes with organizational goals by validating that embedded solutions enhance reliability efficiency and safety for end users in scientific and healthcare communities.
* Support hybrid collaboration practices by using clear written and spoken English communication to share test insights coordinate activities and document outcomes for distributed teams.

**Qualifications**

* Apply advanced experience in Windows XP Embedded to design test scenarios that thoroughly exercise operating system services hardware interfaces and embedded configurations.
* Leverage strong Robot Framework proficiency to structure robust automated suites implement reusable keywords and integrate results reporting for large scale test campaigns.
* Utilize practical Python scripting skills to build utilities for log analysis data generation and test orchestration that streamline validation of complex embedded behaviors.

+ Salesforce Service Cloud
+ Experience Cloud
+ Agentforce
+ Enterprise Service Management
+ ITSM Platforms

+ Incident Management
+ Service Request Management
+ Change Management
+ Problem Management
+ Knowledge Management
+ CMDB
+ IT Asset Management

+ Employee Service Delivery

title: Software Diagnostics & Performance Test Engineer
description:
SOTI is committed to providing its employees with endless possibilities; learning new things, working with the latest technologies and making a difference in the world.
  
  
*SOTI does not charge any fees at any stage of the recruitment process. You can verify the authenticity of any SOTI job opportunities by visiting SOTI Careers. SOTI shall not be liable for any fraudulent recruitment activities carried out by unauthorized individuals or organizations.*
**What You Will Do**

* Investigate complex and ambiguous software failures and performance problems.
* Perform deep root-cause analysis across application, system, network, database, and infrastructure layers.
* Analyze application logs, system logs, stack traces, thread dumps, heap dumps, metrics, traces, and profiling data.
* Analyze network traffic and protocols to identify latency, connectivity, retransmission, timeout, and communication issues.
* Investigate issues that occur only under specific workloads, concurrency levels, configurations, environments, or long-running conditions.
* Understand product architecture and critical customer workflows deeply enough to reason about failure modes.
* Learn the product in depth, including core workflows, customer usage patterns, deployment models, and performance-sensitive areas.
* Design experiments to isolate variables and prove or disprove hypotheses.
* Develop diagnostic scripts, instrumentation, and small tools when necessary to accelerate investigations.
* Perform exploratory testing and deliberately challenge system assumptions to discover weaknesses and failure modes.
* Investigate performance degradation, scalability limitations, resource exhaustion, latency spikes, and throughput bottlenecks.
* Create meaningful Performance Test Cases based on product architecture, customer workflows, expected load patterns, scalability goals, and known risk areas.
* Review Performance Test Cases created by other engineers to ensure coverage, clarity, workload relevance, data validity, and alignment with product behavior.
* Execute Performance Test Cases, analyze results, identify bottlenecks or regressions, and communicate findings with clear evidence and recommended actions.
* Correlate evidence across multiple components of distributed systems.
* Work with developers to identify the actual root cause rather than simply identifying the component where the symptom appeared.
* Clearly communicate technical findings, evidence, root cause, impact, and recommended corrective actions.
* Build and maintain diagnostic knowledge, troubleshooting methodologies, and internal technical documentation.
* Mentor other engineers in systematic debugging and root-cause analysis.

**Must-have Qualifications**

* Technical
* 5+ years of software engineering, performance engineering, systems engineering, reliability engineering, production troubleshooting, or a closely related discipline, preferably in a product-based software company.
* Programming/debugging ability in at least one major language such as Java, C++, C#, Python, etc.
* Strong ability to read and understand unfamiliar application code.
* Demonstrated experience troubleshooting complex software problems.
* Strong understanding of operating-system concepts: processes, threads, memory, CPU, file I/O, sockets, synchronization, resource utilization
* Strong understanding of networking fundamentals: TCP/IP, HTTP/HTTPS, DNS, connection management, latency, timeouts, retransmissions
* Experience analyzing logs and traces across multiple components.
* Experience with application profiling and/or performance analysis.
* Hands-on experience creating, reviewing, and executing Performance Test Cases for complex software products.
* Experience diagnosing concurrency, latency, resource contention, or scalability issues.
* Ability to interpret performance test results, compare them with baselines, identify regressions, and connect findings back to product behavior or code-level causes.
* Ability to formulate hypotheses and systematically validate them with evidence.
* Behavioral
* Exceptional curiosity about how software systems work.
* Strong interest in learning the product deeply rather than treating testing as a black-box activity.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Comfortable working with incomplete or ambiguous information.
* Willingness to challenge assumptions.
* Persistence when the first explanation isn't the real root cause.
* Ability to communicate complex technical findings clearly.
* Comfortable collaborating with developers without simply handing problems back to them.
* Strong ownership of difficult investigations

title: Senior QA Engineer
description:
Job Role: Senior QA Engineer
  
  
Company: Appmaker by StarApps
  
  
Location: Kochi, Kerala (On-Site)
  
  
Experience: 3–5 Years
  
  
Employment Type: Full-time
  
  
**About Appmaker By StarApps**
At StarApps, we build tools like Appmaker that help thousands of global e-commerce merchants turn their web stores into native mobile apps.
  
  
**About The Role**
We're looking for an experienced QA Engineer to take overall ownership of our QA cycle. You'll do hands-on testing, build strong quality control so fewer issues reach QA in the first place, and
  
  
guide our current QA team. Your goal: catch issues early, reduce the number of QA cycles per release, and ship high-quality apps faster.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* QA Ownership: Own the end-to-end QA cycle, from requirement review to final releasesign-off.
* Quality Control: Set up quality checks, entry/exit criteria and checklists that stop issues early and reduce repeat QA cycles.
* Team Guidance: Mentor and guide the current QA team, review their test cases and bug reports, and raise the team's testing standards.
* Test Planning: Create test plans and test cases from the requirements and designs shared, covering functional, regression and edge cases.
* Device & Design Parity Testing: Test on real Android and iOS devices, and run design parity checks against approved designs.
* Bug Management: Report, prioritise and track bugs, document regressed bugs, and verify fixes with the dev team.
* Process Improvement: Find the root causes of recurring bugs and improve QA processes, tools and documentation.
* Communication: Keep management updated on release quality, risks and issues found.
* AI-Assisted Testing: Use AI tools to generate test cases and speed up testing, while reviewing the output carefully.

**What We're Looking For**

* Experience: 3–5 years in software QA, with strong experience testing mobile apps.
* Ownership: Proven experience owning QA for releases and reducing QA cycles or bug
* leakage.
* Leadership: Experience guiding or mentoring junior QA engineers.
* Testing Expertise: Strong knowledge of test planning, functional, regression,
* smoke/sanity testing and the bug life cycle.
* QA Tools: Hands-on experience with QA tools like BrowserStack, Appium and bug
* trackers such as Jira, and the judgment to pick the right tool for the job.
* AI Tools: Experience or strong interest in using AI tools for testing.
* Attention to Detail: You notice when a price, image, spacing or button looks off.
* Communication: Clear written and spoken English for reports, updates and working with developers and management.

**Bonus Points**

* Experience testing Shopify or e-commerce apps.
* Experience with test automation (Appium, Playwright or similar) or API testing (e.g.
* Postman).
* Experience setting up QA processes from scratch in a fast-moving team.

**Why Join Us?**

* Real Impact: Own the quality of apps used by thousands of global brands and millions of shoppers.
* Leadership: Shape how QA works at Appmaker and grow the QA team.
* Modern QA: Work with AI-driven testing tools and a modern workflow.
* Growth & Culture: High ownership and a supportive team in our Kochi office.

Skills:- BrowserStack, Appium, JIRA, Software Testing (QA), Test Automation (QA), Root cause analysis, Playwright and Postman

Technology has always been at the heart of what we do and deliver at EY. We need technology to keep an organization the size of ours working efficiently. We have 250,000 people in more than 140 countries, all of whom rely on secure technology to be able to do their job every single day. Information Security (Info Sec) - Info Sec prevents, detects, responds and mitigates cyber-risk, protecting EY and client data, and our information management systems.

* Participates in special projects and performs other duties as assigned.
* Lead backend system optimization efforts, ensuring high performance, scalability, and responsiveness under varying workloads.
* Spearhead the integration of multiple data sources, APIs, and services, streamlining data flow and improving overall system efficiency.
* Oversee the creation and upkeep of detailed backend documentation, helping cross-functional teams understand architecture and logic.
* Advocate and implement best practices for security, data protection, and backend resilience, aligning with enterprise-grade standards.
* Collaborate with front-end teams to design backend interfaces that support seamless and intuitive user experiences.

* A team player with strong analytical, communication and interpersonal skills
* Constantly updating yourself about new technologies in the market
* A winning personality and the ability to become a trusted advisor to the stakeholders
* Must Have skills : AWS Full stack Java required.
* Typescript

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* Minimum 5 years of experience in software development, system integration, database design, and back-end architecture.
* Bachelor’s degree (B.E./B.Tech) in relevant fields such as Computer Science, or a Master’s degree/Diploma in Computer Science.
* Expertise in server-side development, system integration, and API management; strong knowledge of database design, optimization, debugging, and performance tuning.

title: Lead Business Systems Analyst
description:
**Company Overview**
Milestone Technologies is a global IT managed services firm that partners with organizations to scale their technology, infrastructure and services to drive specific business outcomes such as digital transformation, innovation, and operational agility. Milestone is focused on building an employee-first, performance-based culture and for over 25 years, we have a demonstrated history of supporting category-defining enterprise clients that are growing ahead of the market. The company specializes in providing solutions across Application Services and Consulting, Digital Product Engineering, Digital Workplace Services, Private Cloud Services, AI/Automation, and ServiceNow. Milestone culture is built to provide a collaborative, inclusive environment that supports employees and empowers them to reach their full potential.
  
  
Our seasoned professionals deliver services based on Milestone’s best practices and service delivery framework. By leveraging our vast knowledge base to execute initiatives, we deliver both short-term and long-term value to our clients and apply continuous service improvement to deliver transformational benefits to IT. With Intelligent Automation, Milestone helps businesses further accelerate their IT transformation. The result is a sharper focus on business objectives and a dramatic improvement in employee productivity. Through our key technology partnerships and our people-first approach, Milestone continues to deliver industry-leading innovation to our clients. With more than 3,000 employees serving over 200 companies worldwide, we are following our mission of revolutionizing the way IT is deployed.
  
  
**Job Overview**
Requirements ownership (approx. 80%)
  
  

* Own requirements end to end for Module 3 enablement — elicitation, documentation, prioritisation, traceability from business objective through to delivered capability and acceptance.
* Act as the translator between HEOR business stakeholders and the AI&D and platform engineering teams: convert domain and workflow need into requirements the engineers can build against, and convert technical constraints back into decisions the business can actually make.
* Plan and lead requirements definition working sessions and workshops, bringing the Lead AI Engineer in where feasibility needs to be assessed live rather than discovered later.
* Work with business SMEs to surface nuanced requirements that differ across sections and content types, and document them at a level of precision an engineer can act on without a follow-up conversation.
* Define acceptance criteria for AI-generated content — factual grounding, source traceability, completeness against the section template, tone and terminology consistency — in terms the business owns and the engineers can test against.
* Build on the substantial documentation already produced through the POC work rather than restarting discovery. Establish quickly what is complete, what remains, and what is at risk.
* Refine requirements iteratively across the execution period as SME review cycles reveal what the platform can and cannot yet do, without losing the thread of what was originally agreed.

Delivery coordination (approx. 20%)
  
  

* Hold the pod’s delivery cadence: backlog, sprint rhythm, stand-ups and review cycles, run in the client’s tooling.
* Sequence work realistically against actual capacity and state clearly what can and cannot be delivered within the pilot window.
* Own weekly progress and status reporting to Amgen — at a level of candour that surfaces problems while they are still cheap to fix.
* Identify, log and escalate blockers, risks and dependencies early, particularly those sitting with the core APEX build team, with source-content availability, or with SME review capacity.
* Maintain the risk, issue, decision and assumption log for the engagement.

Stakeholder leadership
  
  

* Hold the day-to-day relationship with HEOR subject-matter experts and the wider business group, and be the single point they come to for scope and progress.
* Coordinate across the three organisations involved — HEOR, AI&D and the platform team — without formal authority over any of them.
* Push back on requirements, scope additions and timeline expectations where the evidence warrants, with reasoning rather than resistance.
* Protect the engineers’ focus: absorb coordination load, filter noise, and ensure they receive requirements that are decided rather than still being argued.
* Document and hand over requirements, decisions and open items in a form the Amgen team can own after the pilot.

**Required Qualifications**

* Experience. 10+ years in business analysis, business systems analysis or a comparable requirements-owning role, including a minimum of 3 years on AI, GenAI, machine learning or intelligent-automation programmes.
* AI lifecycle fluency. Demonstrable experience across the full AI delivery lifecycle — not a single pilot. Practical understanding of hallucination, non-determinism, human-in-the-loop requirements and output variability, and how each changes the way requirements must be written.
* Hands-on GenAI literacy. Working familiarity with GPT/Claude-class tooling — enough to understand how prompting, templatisation and output structuring work, and to hold a credible conversation with engineers about what is and is not achievable.
* Requirements craft. Strong elicitation technique, functional and non-functional specification, acceptance criteria, and traceability discipline across multiple interconnected workstreams.
* Workshop leadership. Proven ability to plan and lead requirements workshops with senior, non-technical business stakeholders and drive them to decisions rather than discussion.
* Delivery discipline. Experience running an agile delivery cadence — backlog, sprints, status reporting, risk and dependency management — for a small team.
* Influence without authority. A track record of holding multiple organisations to commitments from outside all of them, evidenced by unblocking programmes rather than documenting them.
* Autonomy. Demonstrated ability to own a workstream and set its working practices without close supervision, in a client-facing setting.
* Tooling. Proficiency with Jira; familiarity with Smartsheet and SharePoint.
* Communication. Excellent written and verbal English, at the standard required to write for and present to senior commercial stakeholders in the US and Europe, and to disagree constructively.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Prior delivery within a life sciences, pharmaceutical or biotech commercial organisation — market access, HEOR, medical affairs or commercial analytics. Useful context, but not a screening filter.
* Experience with AI-assisted document authoring, content generation, knowledge management or large-scale content transformation.
* Exposure to retrieval-augmented generation and the requirement implications of grounding and source attribution.
* Familiarity with regulated or GxP-adjacent documentation environments and their traceability expectations.
* Experience in a self-directed vendor pod operating alongside, but independently of, a client’s internal build team.
* Formal certification in business analysis (CBAP/CCBA), agile delivery (CSPO, PSM) or project management (PMP).

**Compensation**
Estimated Pay Range:
  
  
Exact compensation and offers of employment are dependent on circumstances of each case and will be determined based on job-related knowledge, skills, experience, licenses or certifications, and location.

title: PC-1451-QA Engineer
description:
**QA Engineer – Manual + Automation**
**Role Summary**
We are looking for a skilled QA Engineer (Manual + Automation) to join the engineering team at Softobiz supporting the Pickles web transformation project. You will be responsible for designing and executing comprehensive test strategies that span manual, automation, API, regression, and release validation testing across the platform.
  
  
The ideal candidate brings strong hands-on experience with both manual testing practices and modern test automation frameworks, with a solid understanding of CI/CD integration, API testing, and end-to-end quality assurance across web applications. You will collaborate closely with developers, product managers, and DevOps engineers to ensure the highest levels of product quality and a reliable, release-ready codebase throughout the development lifecycle.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Manual Testing**

* Design, write, and execute detailed test cases and test plans for functional, regression, integration, and exploratory testing of web applications.
* Perform cross-browser and cross-device compatibility testing to ensure consistent user experiences.
* Conduct end-to-end manual validation of user stories and acceptance criteria, working closely with product and design stakeholders.
* Identify, document, and track defects using issue-tracking tools (e.g., Jira), ensuring clear reproduction steps, severity classification, and timely resolution.
* Participate in sprint ceremonies including backlog grooming, sprint planning, and retrospectives to ensure quality is built into every stage of the process.

**Automation Testing**

* Design, develop, and maintain scalable test automation frameworks for web applications using tools such as Playwright, Selenium, Cypress, or equivalent.
* Write clean, reusable, and maintainable automated test scripts in TypeScript or JavaScript.
* Integrate automated test suites into CI/CD pipelines (e.g., GitHub Actions) to enable continuous testing on every build.
* Monitor and analyse automated test results, investigate flaky tests, and maintain a high level of automation coverage across critical user journeys.
* Contribute to test strategy discussions and advocate for automation-first approaches where appropriate.

**API Testing**

* Design and execute comprehensive API test suites for RESTful services using tools such as Postman, RestAssured, or equivalent.
* Validate request/response payloads, status codes, authentication flows, and error handling across API contracts.
* Collaborate with backend developers to review API specifications and flag potential issues before implementation.
* Automate API test collections and integrate them into the CI/CD pipeline for continuous API quality validation.

**Regression Testing**

* Own and maintain the regression test suite, ensuring comprehensive coverage of core platform functionality.
* Execute full and targeted regression cycles ahead of each release, clearly documenting scope, results, and sign-off status.
* Identify areas of the application most susceptible to regression risk and prioritise automation coverage accordingly.
* Track and report regression metrics over time to support continuous quality improvement.

**Release Validation**

* Act as the quality gate for each release, coordinating release validation activities across environments (dev, staging, production).
* Prepare and execute release checklists, smoke tests, and sanity checks to confirm production readiness.
* Work with DevOps and engineering leads to validate deployments and sign off on go-live readiness.
* Document release test outcomes and communicate clearly to stakeholders on quality status and any outstanding risks.

**Quality Engineering & Collaboration**

* Collaborate with developers, product managers, and designers to define acceptance criteria and establish a shared definition of done.
* Champion a quality-first culture within the team through proactive defect prevention, shift-left testing practices, and continuous feedback.
* Maintain up-to-date test documentation, including test plans, test reports, and traceability matrices.
* Mentor junior QA team members and contribute to QA best practices and internal knowledge sharing.

**Required Technical Skills**
**Domain**
**Skills & Technologies**
**Must / Preferred**
Manual Testing Test case design, exploratory testing, UAT, regression, cross-browser testing
**Must**
Automation Framework Playwright, Cypress, or Selenium; Page Object Model (POM); reusable test architecture
**Must**
Languages TypeScript, JavaScript
**Must**
API Testing Postman, RestAssured or equivalent; REST API validation, contract testing
**Must**
CI/CD Integration GitHub Actions or equivalent; integrating test suites into build pipelines
**Must**

**Must**
Test Management TestRail, Zephyr, or equivalent; test plans, traceability matrices, test reporting
**Must**
Regression Testing Regression suite ownership, coverage strategy, scheduled regression cycles
**Must**
Release Validation Release checklists, smoke/sanity testing, environment validation, go-live sign-off
**Must**
Performance Testing JMeter, k6, or equivalent for load and performance validation
**Preferred**
Security Testing Basic OWASP awareness, vulnerability scanning basics
**Preferred**
Cloud & DevOps AWS or Azure – deployment environments; Docker basics for local test environments
**Preferred**
AI / Dev Tools AI-assisted test generation (Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor)
**Preferred**
Observability Log analysis, AppInsights, or ELK stack for identifying failures post-deploy
**Preferred**
**Qualifications & Certifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
* 4–7 years of hands-on QA experience covering both manual and automation testing in production web application environments.
* Demonstrable experience building and maintaining automation frameworks using Playwright, Cypress, or Selenium.
* Hands-on experience with API testing using Postman or equivalent – this is a mandatory requirement.
* Proven ownership of regression test suites and release validation activities in an agile delivery context.
* Experience working in agile, cross-functional product teams – ideally in a global or client-facing delivery context.

**Preferred Certifications**

* ISTQB Foundation Level or Advanced Level (Test Analyst / Technical Test Analyst)
* Playwright or Cypress official certifications (where available)
* Any relevant cloud or DevOps certifications (AWS, Azure, GitHub Actions)

**Soft Skills & Cultural Fit**

* Strong written and verbal communication skills – able to articulate test findings, risk assessments, and quality status clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Comfortable working independently during IST hours while collaborating with international clients and team members across different time zones.
* High sense of ownership over quality outcomes – proactively identifies gaps and drives issues to resolution without constant supervision.
* Collaborative team player who actively participates in sprint ceremonies, code reviews, and cross-functional quality discussions.
* Curious, growth-oriented mindset – proactively upskills on new testing tools, frameworks, and AI-enabled QA practices.

**What We Offer**

* Opportunity to work on real-world product engineering for Pickles – one of Australia’s leading vehicle remarketing platforms.
* Exposure to modern web architectures and the full software delivery lifecycle in a fast-moving, collaborative engineering team.
* Technically strong team with a culture of code quality, continuous improvement, and knowledge sharing.
* Competitive compensation, professional development support, and access to emerging AI development tools.
* Flexible working arrangements – hybrid options available depending on location.

**About Softobiz**
Softobiz is a technology firm. We build software and run dedicated offshore teams — Global Capability Centres — for a portfolio of international clients across multiple markets. We are looking for an Operations Manager to run the operations of the whole business: the delivery
  
  
engine behind our GCCs, and the day-to-day running of the company itself. Just as important, we want someone who treats operations as something to be continuously sharpened — not just kept running. A core part of this role is reviewing how we work, redesigning processes that are manual or inefficient, automating them, and bringing AI deeply into how the operation runs. We are a technology company and we expect our operations to reflect that. Strategy and commercials sit with leadership; your job is to make the operation run, make it run
*better*
over time, report on it clearly, and escalate the right things at the right time. You will have an operations support resource handling day-to-day administrative and coordination tasks beneath you.
  
  
**For more information about our solutions and organization, visit www.softobiz.com, Follow us on Twitter, Facebook, and LinkedIn.**

title: Engineering Systems Support Analyst
description:
**Job Description**
 The role focuses on supporting Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) systems and related engineering applications, ensuring data integrity, system reliability, and efficient operation across integrated business platforms. Responsibilities include application support, data analysis, SQL reporting, troubleshooting, documentation, process improvement, and collaboration with engineering, IT, and business stakeholders.
   

  

 The analyst will work closely with design engineers, product development teams, IT professionals, and third\-party vendors to resolve technical issues, improve system performance, and support engineering processes. Candidates should enjoy problem solving, working with data, learning new technologies, and supporting enterprise applications within an engineering and manufacturing environment. As experience grows, the role will progress toward ownership of engineering systems, business processes, and system improvement initiatives.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Provide technical support for PLM systems and associated engineering applications across multiple business units and engineering disciplines.
* Investigate, troubleshoot, and resolve application, system, and data\-related issues while ensuring minimal disruption to engineering operations.
* Write, maintain, and execute SQL queries to support reporting, data validation, data reconciliation, and engineering business processes.
* Monitor and maintain data integrity, accuracy, and consistency across PLM and integrated enterprise systems.
* Support engineering teams in the effective use of engineering systems, business applications, and product data management processes.
* Assist in analysing engineering and product data to identify discrepancies, investigate root causes, and recommend corrective actions.
* Collaborate with internal stakeholders and third\-party vendors to gather requirements, support projects, and resolve technical issues.
* Support system enhancements, upgrades, testing activities, and implementation of process improvements.
* Contribute to the development and maintenance of reports, dashboards, validation tools, and business intelligence outputs that support engineering operations.
* Assist with administration and routine maintenance activities for Windows Server environments supporting engineering applications.
* Produce and maintain technical documentation, user guides, process documentation, test reports, release notes, and technical specifications.
* Support user training activities and assist in developing subject matter expertise within engineering and business teams.
* Take ownership of assigned tasks and support activities, proactively driving issues through resolution while communicating progress, risks, and recommendations to stakeholders.
* Ensure compliance with company procedures, quality standards, and engineering governance requirements.
* The successful candidate will work under guidance of Senior Analyst, who will oversee their workload and scheduling.


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree in information systems, Computer Science, Data Analytics, Software Engineering, Engineering Technology, or a related discipline.
* Master's degree in information systems, Software Engineering, Engineering, or a related subject is preferred.
* 1\-3 years of experience supporting business applications, enterprise systems, engineering systems, or technical software platforms, with hands\-on experience using SQL for reporting, data analysis, data validation, and troubleshooting data\-related issues.
* Understanding of relational database concepts, data structures, and relationships between enterprise systems.
* Exposure to enterprise platforms such as PLM, ERP, Product Data Management (PDM), Document Management, CAD, or similar engineering systems is preferred.
* Familiarity with technologies such as Microsoft SQL Server, VB.NET, ASP.NET, Visual Studio, JSON, XML, XSLT, ODBC databases, and Web Services is advantageous.
* Basic knowledge of Windows Server environments, application hosting platforms, and system administration concepts.
* Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills with the ability to investigate and resolve technical and data\-related issues.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to collaborate effectively across engineering, business, and IT teams.
* Demonstrates ownership by taking responsibility for issues, following through on actions, and driving tasks to completion.
* Shows curiosity and initiative by continuously learning new systems, technologies, and business processes.
* Communicates proactively, builds positive working relationships, and effectively collaborates with internal stakeholders and external partners.
* Produces accurate, well\-documented, and maintainable solutions while maintaining a high standard of quality.
* Approaches challenges with professionalism, persistence, and a customer\-focused mindset.
* Experience within an engineering, manufacturing, industrial, or operational environment is desirable.

 As an organization jointly owned by the business and IT, the MST is a centralized and global organization that will provide operational support for an integrated, SAP\-centric platform (Mercury) and manage and support the Mercury user community. The MST will play an integral governance role in the global Mercury solution and will evolve to work closely with the business to enable the benefit and value to be realized from the investment in Mercury and to set the future direction and technology road map.
   

  

 Business Efficiency and Evolution is one of the four core functions of the MST. Business Efficiency and Evolution will work closely with the business and the Global Process Owners to set the strategic direction and road map for Mercury, enabling process efficiency and standardization through:
   

  

* centralized business process governance
* portfolio planning, demand management and prioritization
* analysis of business requirements and the identification of process improvement opportunities, aligned with business KPIs, which can be delivered via the Mercury solution
* robust governance, stewardship and audit of Mercury data
* effective governance and management of the Mercury control framework.


 As a part of the Business Efficiency and Evolution function, the Data Steward Technical plays a key role in driving the benefit and value from the Mercury solution. Working with key stakeholders in MST IT and Business functions, the Mercury Program, and firm wide Data Governance Stakeholders, the Data Steward is responsible for the implementation of the firm’s data management metrics and improvement strategies. This includes the enablement and support of data advocacy, stewardship and audit including the definition and implementation of standards, guidelines, approved workflow processes, systems and KPIs for key master data objects in Mercury scope.
   

  

 Data Stewards’ primary function is to design, implement and enhance systems, tools and solutions to enable the MST data governance function. Accountability for enablement of data quality enhancement and effective data stewardship in line with defined Mercury / EY data standards and the agreed Mercury change and release management process. Ensure adoption and enforcement of best practices by implementing KPIs.
   

  

 Success in the role will be evaluated based on the specific goals for implementation of data quality metrics and the direct, tangible cost reductions and business benefits derived from their continuous improvement activities.

 (Identify and describe essential functions, or primary duties and responsibilities. Assume that the reader does not know the role or function of the job.)
   

  

* Design, implement and enhance automated data quality assessments, compliance metrics and KPIs.
* Design, implement and enhance automated data profiling and integration of internal and external data sources required for effective governance.
* Proactively identify data governance opportunities associated with business issues and risks and develop solutions to mitigate risk and improve efficiency.
* Demonstrate skill to pro\-actively identify critical or key master\- and reference data elements associated with business issues to be included in the governance function.
* Understand business issues and risks from a system, process and control, and most importantly a data perspective.
* Facilitate and enable accurate documentation of metadata, lineage, models, interfaces, transformations and other activity in the data life cycle with impact on risks associated with key data elements.

* Produce key measurements that communicate governance performance, including KPIs, monthly achievements, project status and issues to be addressed
* Translate team priorities into actionable plans to meet strategic objectives of the Data Governance function.
* Develop multiple relationships across the organization and own team, based on authenticity and respect. Leverage networks across the organization, working with diverse teams so that the Data Governance function is credible and valued across EY. Other parts of the business include IT, Finance, Data Privacy (GCO), Risk, Business Reporting Group, Service Lines Leaders, Area leadership, Talent Leadership
* Go beyond technical excellence aspects to provide insights including thought leadership, embedding leading practice methods and processes to deliver value from Data Governance function.
* Serve as the primary quality control analyst for all master data entities in the primary databases
* Serve as contributor and subject area expert in the collaborative review of new data designs and development.
* Escalate data management decisions that cannot be made easily or due to unresolved conflict
* Provide a business case and resource estimates for development work required for Governance processes and data quality profiling, monitoring and reporting
* Provide expert knowledge through research and acquired business knowledge

 (Describe the kind of problems and challenges typically faced, and decisions required to perform the job, as well as recommendations made to supervisors or others. Provide an example.)
   

  

* Report on, and support through enforcement, the agreed and signed\-off policies mandated by the Data governance policy.
* Identify data governance metrics and execute audits to benchmark the state of data quality, retention, security etc., and its impact on desired business outcomes.
* Regularly expose data governance metrics via standard reporting mechanisms (for example, data quality scorecard or dashboard).
* Engage with business leadership (key business managers, Talent leadership etc.), to quantify and articulate the business impact of violations of policy.
* Develop data quality methodologies to execute data quality improvement projects.
* Actively participate in the design and deployment of applications and data integration processes to ensure standards and controls, to ensure high\-quality data is implemented in adherence with data governance policies.


**Knowledge and Skills Requirements:**
 (Describe the knowledge or skills needed to perform this job; these may be technical, managerial or behavioral in nature.)
   

  

* Comprehensive understanding of the importance and impact of data (or bad data) on the ability of the business to meet its objectives.
* Aptitude to gain in\-depth knowledge of EY's systems, data and key business processes.
* Understanding of how data is used within business processes and its impact on desired business process outcomes, derived from multiple years of exposure to the EY business setting.


**This is for BODS/Info Steward candidates**
* Demonstrate strong understanding and usage of Information Steward Components on Data Insight, Metadata Management, Matapedia, Cleansing Package Builder, Match Review, SAP Data Services (BODS/DS) , SAP MDM / MDG , SQL (advanced) and Custom attributes build.
* Comprehensive understanding of data analytics solutions, data conversion implementations and tools, ERP data models, data warehouse models, data profiling techniques, ETL/data integration tools and technology, MDM solutions, and SDLC.
* Ability to perform and manage multiple tasks simultaneously and work well under pressure and with time constraints demonstrating strong organizational skills
* Strong aptitude working at low levels of detail, examining data and trends in values to understand variations and seek the root causes, to legitimize the trend or classify it as a data governance issue.

Describe the level of supervision of others, if any (i.e., assigning work, reviewing performance, direct or indirect responsibility).

**Experience**

* 3\+ years’ experience in a global professional services firm performing data management and/or governance, system integration, implementing data analytics, warehouse, MDM and/or BI solutions in a
* Understanding of the end\-to\-end data life cycle requirements of key business processes.


**This is for BODS/Info Steward candidates**

* Project management training, practical application experience is preferred.
* Exposure to data quality, records management, security and privacy concepts, best practices, and tools/technologies
* EY Knowledge a plus but not a requirement Experience in change management, configuration management, or incident management would be a plus.

* Having certification of the relevant skill is a plus but not required.

title: Quality Assurance Engineer
description:
**Key Responsibilities:** 



* **Test Automation Development:** 
 Design, develop and maintain automated test suites in Python using pytest and Selenium, and keyword\-driven suites in Robot Framework. Identify automation candidates within existing manual regression packs and convert them into reliable, reusable, data\-driven tests.
* **Framework Maintenance \& Code Quality:** 
 Extend shared automation libraries, page objects, custom keywords and test utilities. Participate in peer code reviews and keep suites maintainable, deterministic and free of flaky tests.
* **Regression \& Release Testing:** 
 Set up test environments and tools, then execute automated and manual regression cycles for official releases, verifying core functionality across supported platforms and configurations.
* **Test Environment Support:** 
 Deploy, configure and troubleshoot test environments on Linux, including Docker\-based and Kubernetes\-based deployments, and manage test data and environment configuration.
* **Defect Analysis \& Root Cause Investigation:** 
 Reproduce, isolate and troubleshoot defects using application logs, Linux tooling and monitoring dashboards. Perform root cause analysis, collaborate with developers on resolution, and log actionable, well\-evidenced bug reports.
* **Run Monitoring \& Reporting:** 
 Monitor scheduled and overnight automated runs, triage failures, track latency issues and application health checks, and deliver clear execution reports covering both manual and automated results.
* **Collaboration \& Process Improvement:** 
 Work with developers, QA colleagues and stakeholders to clarify requirements, review test coverage, and continuously refine testing workflows and engineering efficiency.



  





**Required Qualifications:** 



* 2\+ years of hands\-on experience as a QA Engineer, with proven expertise in both manual and automated testing.
* Strong proficiency in Python for test automation development (modules, OOP, standard libraries).
* Hands\-on experience with pytest and Selenium WebDriver for building and executing automated suites.
* Proven experience in designing, setting up and executing manual and automated regression suites and analysing test results.
* Experience with Git (branching, merge requests, code reviews) and CI/CD pipelines such as Jenkins or GitLab CI for triggering automated suites.
* Strong command of Linux for test execution, log analysis and troubleshooting (shell, grep/awk, services, processes)
* Experience with Jira (issue and defect tracking) and Confluence (documentation).
* Strong defect investigation skills (ability to identify, reproduce, analyse root causes and report issues).
* Clear communication skills with the ability to present detailed execution and bug reports to stakeholders.



  





**Nice\-to\-Have Skills** 



* Exposure to Kubernetes for deploying, inspecting and debugging test environments.
* Experience with log analysis and monitoring stacks (ELK / Kibana, Grafana).
* Experience with additional automation frameworks and tools, including performance or load testing.
* Experience in desktop testing for Windows\-based applications.
* Familiarity with Agile/Scrum methodologies.
* Knowledge of Financial Markets / Trading.

title: QA Executive & Aquaculture Field Technician
description:
This job is provided by apna.co Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Raw Material Inspection


  Assess species, size, grade, freshness, and physical condition.
   

  

  Verify receiving temperature and condition of chilled/frozen materials.
   

  

  Ensure supplier/lot identification and traceability. Reject or hold materials that fail to meet specifications.
   

  

* Processing Monitoring


  Oversee washing, grading, deheading/peeling, freezing, and glazing. Verify product temperature at
   

  

 critical stages.
   

  

  Ensure compliance with SOPs and product specifications.
   

  

* HACCP \& Food Safety


  Monitor CCPs/OPRPs and critical limits.
   

  

  Record monitoring results and act immediately on deviations.
   

  

  Verify corrective actions and follow\-up measures.
   

  

* Personal Hygiene \& GMP


  Monitor worker hygiene and protective clothing.
   

  

  Ensure proper handwashing/sanitization practices.
   

  

  Enforce GMP and GHP standards in processing areas.
   

  

* Hazard Control


  Monitor cleaning and sanitation chemicals.
   

  

  Prevent chemical and foreign\-body contamination.
   

  

  Inspect equipment, utensils, and processing areas for hygiene.
   

  

* Finished Product Inspection


  Check appearance, colour, odour, texture, size/grade, weight, glazing, packaging, and labelling.
   

  

  Verify product against customer and internal specifications.
   

  

* Packaging \& Labelling


  Confirm correct packaging materials are used.
   

  

  Verify product details: name, species, grade, net weight, production/expiry dates, lot/batch number,
   

  

 storage instructions. Ensure compliance with customer\-specific requirements.
   

  

* Cold Chain Monitoring


  Monitor freezing, cold\-room, and dispatch temperatures.
   

  

  Ensure frozen products are maintained at ≤ −18°C.
   

  

  Record and report deviations.
   

  

* Traceability


  Maintain traceability from raw material to dispatch.
   

  

  Verify GRN, production, packing, and dispatch records.
   

  

* Non\-Conformance \& Corrective Action


  Identify and segregate non\-conforming products/processes.
   

  

  Raise NCRs and investigate root causes. Verify corrective/preventive actions.
   

  

* Documentation


  Maintain QC inspection records, CCP monitoring logs, temperature checks, sanitation reports, product
   

  

 inspection reports, calibration records, etc. Ensure records are complete, accurate, and audit\-ready.
   

  

* Field Aquaculture Supervision


  To travel to farm location in and around Alappuzha and collect and report aquaculture farm data
   

  

 weekly/monthly as per company requirements and report it to the respective teams.
   

  

  Provide technical support and ensure compliance with Best Aquaculture practise standards for Basa
   

  

 farming/ Shrimp farming/ other species. Supervise harvesting and dispatch operations.
   

  

  Maintain detailed records of farming activities and produce reports for each visit.
   

  

 Skills \& Attributes
   

  

  Basic computer and MS office skills.
   

  

  Analytical thinking and attention to detail.
   

  

  Strong communication skills, especially in explaining technical concepts to farmers.
   

  

  Adaptability to diverse field conditions and travel requirements.
   

  

  Ability to work independently and in teams.
   

  

  Relationship\-building and trust with aquaculture farmers and train them in aquaculture techniques
   

  

 during field visits.
